description: React component for rendering list items in the Notesnook app, handling various item types such as notes, notebooks, reminders, tags, and search results, with dynamic data fetching and rendering logic.

methods.name: refreshItem
methods.description: Updates component state with resolved item data, including tags, notebooks, reminders, colors, and counts, based on item type.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Calculates the sort date for a given item based on group options or default sorting.
